informal_statement: For \(0<\lambda<1\) and every real \(R\), the derivative of \(c\mapsto H(c,R)/c\) at \(\lambda\) is \(R L(\lambda,R)/\lambda^2\).
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:1480-1500`: The source proves the ordinary density derivative \((R/\lambda ^2)\cdot L\) for every real \(R\) under the two density bounds. The author correctly separates this identity from the additional \(R>\lambda\) condition needed for negativity.
